name: microsoft-wcp
_comment: Microsoft's WCP banner (#wcpConsentBannerCtrl; user report microsoft.com 2026-10-20, 'failed'). autoconsent's 'microsoft.com' rule (disabled in consent.json) finds the buttons by English/German text ('Reject|Ablehnen') and throws in every other language. The three buttons are in the same order in every locale: accept, reject, manage cookies.
